verified_behaviour: Every selected source frame is passed first to 640 and then to 1280 using identical detector settings except image size
Decoded BGR uint8 pixel SHA256 is recorded before inference
Shared frozen background confirmation, cross-class suppression, containment suppression and fresh ByteTrack are applied in that order
Original 640 detection indices are preserved through background filtering, both suppression stages and tracker output
Raw 1280 detections, confirmation candidates, retained and removed indices, containment ambiguities and final tracker inputs remain in each frame record
Policy source, source SHA256, camera, dimensions and model SHA256 must match
Changed or missing policy files, unsupported modes and incomplete second-resolution inference fail closed
Policy files and vehicle_containment.py are included in run provenance fingerprints
Historical caches cannot silently discard containment or claim a rule not present in their stored records
Existing audited CFR/PTS, bounded tracking state, streaming outputs and Main Test exclusion regression tests passed
limits: Software tests are synthetic adapter and provenance checks, not detection or traffic-count accuracy measurements
Real same-frame parity and the one-hour run are separate required checks
